Everyone who is credited for good in Guarana: 59 people, from 499 commits since 2026-11-13. The same list, with faces, is the [Hall of fame](https://karimalsalah.github.io/guarana/legacy.html) on the website.

Your name is added here when a pull request of yours is merged, or when a merged commit names you in a `Co-authored-by:` trailer. It is rebuilt daily from the git history, and it stays.

## Tools

AI tools and bots that helped are listed here, apart from the people: a person owns every pull request, and the tool is named by its `Co-authored-by:` or `Assisted-by:` line.

| Claude | 353 |

| OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT | 3 |

## What counts

Commits since 2026-11-13, the first day of Guarana. Before that the history is the upstream projects' (Lichii, Eglantine, Eden, yuzu), credited in [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md) and in git itself. Merge commits are not counted. Trailer e-mail addresses are only used to find a GitHub login and are not published.
